notes: The 5.85.2 fix dated MUC-backlog replays by their delay stamp — and the owner's very next reconnect stored a FIFTH copy at receipt time, because the fix read only the modern urn:xmpp:delay while Openfire delivers MUC history under the LEGACY jabber:x:delay (XEP-0091) with the compact CCYYMMDDThh:mm:ss stamp. Both dialects now read as one replay: the legacy stamp is normalized to ISO (UTC with no zone, per its own spec), a stamp that normalizes to nothing yields history-with-no-usable-date rather than a fabricated one, and the replay dedup finally bites on the wire Openfire actually sends.
